items.name: Foundation 8 × 8 m
items.description: A larger concrete foundation for quickly building broad quays. Joins the same 4 m structural grid and extends down to the seabed.

items.name: Quay section
items.description: A concrete landing along the waterfront.

items.name: Timber pier
items.description: A small pier on supporting posts.

items.name: Mooring bollard
items.description: Existing harbour bollard. Place on a foundation, quay or pier.

items.name: Container crane + yard
items.description: Existing harbour T-crane and container yard. The cargo area follows the crane's reach along the quay. Arrow faces water. Place on foundations.
